summary: Wave-2 Forinthry place expansion: 7 real Wilderness surface places after wave-1 (Daemonheim, Agility, Mage of Zamorak, Crater, Forinthry Dungeon, Mage Arena). Display name stays Wilderness; id stays forinthry. Fort Forinthry stays Misthalin. Mandrith already covered by content 'Wilderness Slayer (Mandrith)' — not re-added.

Chaos Temple (Wilderness).note: Disambiguated from Chaos Temple (hut) at level 38; this is the level-13 gilded-altar Prayer site.

Bandit Camp.note: Catalog short form matches other single-region camps; wiki disambiguator is (Wilderness).

deferred.name: Mandrith content row
deferred.reason: Already present as content 'Wilderness Slayer (Mandrith)' after wave-1 rename; Crater remains the hub place pin.

content.name: King Black Dragon
content.detail: Classic multi-style dragon boss. Surface approach is the Lava Maze / artefact path in deep-mid Wilderness; the lair itself is not dangerous Wilderness, so teleports work inside. Lair access is the Forinthry geography dependency for ironman self-supply, not a claim that the arena tiles are Wilderness levels.

content.name: Chaos Temple Prayer altar
content.detail: Level-13 Wilderness Chaos Temple altar. Members get gilded-altar behaviour when offering bones or ashes — primary Wilderness Prayer train. Distinct from the small Chaos Temple hut near the Frozen Waste Plateau.

content.name: Banite rocks (Pirates' Hideout mine)
content.detail: Level-54 Pirates' Hideout mine — banite rock cluster for high-level Mining ladder in the deep north. Ironman ore path that is geographically Forinthry/Wilderness.

ops.rule: Dungeoneering through Daemonheim requires the Forinthry/Wilderness region.
Fort Forinthry Construction/Slayer hub stays Misthalin working taxonomy until Equilibrium publishes otherwise — not unlocked by the Forinthry/Wilderness pick alone.
Abyss surface entrance (Mage of Zamorak) is Forinthry/Wilderness geography; rune-altar destinations remain their own regions.

ops.text: Display name on regionAnchors remains Wilderness; league/catalog id remains forinthry. Do not rename. Mandrith not re-added as content — wave-1 already has Wilderness Slayer (Mandrith); pin hub place is Wilderness Crater.
